up: Find all distinct compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5726550'. Return the molecule's ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and the compound name as recorded in the compound_records table (compound_records.compound_name). Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726550', join docs with compound_records via doc_id, then with molecule_dictionary via molregno. Do not add any extra filters or limit the number of rows.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cr.compound_name
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5726550';
